name: patient_soap_summary_tool
description: Summarize a patient's longitudinal clinical notes into one concise SOAP note (Subjective, Objective, Assessment, Plan) using a local Ollama Qwen model.

runtime.notes: Runs locally against an Ollama server (default http://127.0.0.1:11434) using a Qwen model. GPU is used automatically if available.

help.summary: Condense a patient's full longitudinal clinical notes into a single concise SOAP note via a local Ollama Qwen model.
notes: Requires a running Ollama server with a Qwen model pulled (set OLLAMA_MODEL / OLLAMA_HOST to override).
Upload a .txt clinical note first, then run this tool.
